name: Direct Lake
short_description: Direct Lake is a storage mode for Power BI semantic models in Microsoft Fabric that reads Delta tables directly from OneLake instead of importing a copy or querying the source on every click.

evidence.quote: Direct Lake is Microsoft's attempt to end that trade off
